data.body: **[P2] Finish the resumed request before requiring completed telemetry.** The `timeout-retry` lifecycle case returns while the second request still owns the unreleased fault gate. Once its `OTEL_ENTER` is visible, this assertion requires an `OTEL_EXIT` that cannot arrive until that request finishes; the gate is released only during subsequent teardown. A correctly running retry therefore produces `CollectionError`. Preserve the lifecycle observations, then release and finish the resumed request before validating completed telemetry. Add a regression covering an active retry.
